name: GhostSkeleton
description: Non-interactive loading placeholder. useGhostSkeleton owns aria-hidden and inert; GhostSkeleton is the thin unstyled element. Themed shape lives on @ghostvue/themes.

props.name: as
props.description: Rendered root element. Choose the tag that is valid in the parent context. Interactive and void elements are excluded.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Optional. Leave empty. Content inside stays hidden from assistive technology with the root.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The single rendered element selected by as.

keyboard.Tab: Moves past the skeleton. The root is inert and is not a tab stop.
